confirm.subject: Confirm your e-mail for the WE Invoice e-invoicing beta
confirm.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your interest in the e-invoicing beta in WE Invoice. To add you to the list, please confirm your e-mail by clicking the link:

{confirmUrl}

The link is valid for 7 days. If you didn't sign up, just ignore this e-mail; without confirmation we won't add you to anything and we'll delete your details.

WE Invoice: invoicing and e-invoicing, free. Your data stays with you.
{siteUrl}
